profile.targetRole: AI Product Manager / AI Product Ops
profile.background: Business / information systems background; strong user research and storytelling; one AI hackathon and several product prototypes; weak evidence of production metrics or technical delivery ownership.

trends.name: AI Workflow Redesign
trends.note: Teams increasingly need model capability translated into measurable business workflows.

trends.name: Human-in-the-loop Eval Ops
trends.note: Evaluation, fallback and review operations are becoming explicit product requirements.

trends.name: Generic AI PM
trends.note: Role label is common; differentiated evidence is the bottleneck.

trends.name: Prompt Library Management
trends.note: Easy to imitate and weak as a standalone career signal.

wedge.name: AI Workflow + Evaluation PM
wedge.thesis: The wedge is not generic AI product knowledge but the ability to redesign a workflow, define evaluation criteria, design human fallback and show measurable before/after behavior.
wedge.killCriteria: Target roles consistently value shipped-user metrics over workflow/eval design and prototypes cannot obtain any real-user signal.
wedge.nextTest: Redesign one real knowledge-work flow and compare baseline vs AI-assisted quality, time and revision effort.

proofs.name: AI-assisted Research Workflow
proofs.evidence: Workflow diagram + product spec + eval rubric + result table

claims.claim: Designed an AI-assisted research workflow with evidence verification and human approval
claims.ownership: Workflow design, evaluation rubric, fallback logic
claims.risk: Why is this a product problem rather than just prompt engineering?
Was quality preserved? How was revision effort measured?

position.safe: AI product builder focused on workflow redesign, evaluation and human-in-the-loop systems.
position.stretch: AI Product candidate who can define workflow metrics, evaluation criteria and operational guardrails for LLM products.
position.gaps: Real users; production rollout; retention/usage metrics; cross-functional delivery ownership.

applications.next: Send product case with baseline/eval artifacts

interview.risk: Claiming product impact without production user metrics
interview.weakness: Current proof is strong on workflow/evaluation but weak on shipped adoption and business outcomes.
interview.drill: What user behavior changed, how did you measure quality, and what would you instrument in production?
